subject: english
question:
**Direction: Fill in the blank with the most appropriate choice:**

At the ______ of the century the early evangelistic zeal of the chief Protestant denominations had notably lessened.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The given sentence wants to convey that the main Protestant faiths' early evangelical zeal had noticeably diminished by the century's close.
 
• **"End"** means the conclusion or termination of something. (अंत; समाप्ति)
 
 
• **Example:** *My house is at the **end**__ of the street.*
 
 
 
• *​*So, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct sentence:** *At the __**end**__ of the century the early evangelistic zeal of the chief Protestant denominations had notably lessened.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let us explore other options:
 
 
• **"Final"** means last. (अंतिम (क्रम की दृष्टि से))
 
• **"Angst"** means anxiety or fear. (स्थिति या जीवन के बारे में चिंता और व्‍याकुलता की भावना)
 
• **"Ante"** means before or in front of (in this context). (पूर्व, अग्र, पूर्ववर्ती)
